review M2, exhaustive outcome table fixed before the run (Owner item 3, bounded). A REASONABLE candidate is (i) the tool SELECTED or SELECTED_BORDERLINE arm if it SHOWS_IMPROVEMENT, and (ii) the FIRST_DISTINGUISHED arm if its rate is inside the qualifying band 0.43 < rate < 0.57 (also when it is not the tool selection). Outcomes: REASONABLE_CANDIDATE = at least one arm satisfies (i) or (ii); if (i) and (ii) name different arms, both go to the Owner; a BORDERLINE arm always goes to the Owner as an explicit decision. STOP_NO_REASONABLE_CANDIDATE = every other case, including NO_CANDIDATE, a selection that is IN_BAND_NOT_DISTINGUISHED_FROM_BASE with no in-band distinguished arm, NOT_REPRODUCED, and the tool outcomes INSTRUMENT (control out of range or more than 1% errors) and INCONCLUSIVE. After INSTRUMENT / INCONCLUSIVE only the Owner may decide to re-run this same registration unchanged (no arm change, no new seeds chosen after seeing data, no new round). Whatever the outcome, this is the LAST screening round for mid_jungle_sync: STOP_NO_REASONABLE_CANDIDATE leaves it unchanged with its confirmation risk
